fire-breath.desc: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 63 (18d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

teleport.manual: O cão leva junto o que veste e carrega, e pode fazer uma mordida antes ou depois de teleportar.
teleport.manualEn: The dog takes what it wears and carries, and may make one bite attack before or after teleporting.
teleport.desc: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.
